settings.eyebrow: Chapter One · Look after the art
settings.heading: Earned. Not given.
Sealed, because the routine is the product.
settings.lead: One set. Two formulas. Restore Balm for fresh work. Recovery Cream for the second stage and the months after.
settings.body: Detailed work needs both. No single product does the job, so they don't come apart. Not as a discount. As a discipline.
settings.micro_1: Ships in 1–2 days from Surfers Paradise

settings.label: Step one · Days 1–14
settings.name: Restore Balm
settings.body: A concentrated balm that lays down a protective layer and holds moisture in while the work closes over. Thin layer, clean dry skin, morning and night.

settings.label: Step two · The months after
settings.name: Recovery Cream
settings.body: A lighter daily cream that sinks in fast to hydrate and soothe while the work settles. The stage most people skip. Don't.

settings.heading: Two stages. Two formulas.
settings.intro: Fresh work needs sealing. Settling work needs conditioning. The balm is too heavy for the second stage; the cream too light for the first.
settings.outro: Heavy, detailed work uses both, layered. Fifteen years in the chair says one product can't do it. That is why they're sealed together.

settings.heading: Built at the counter of a working studio.
settings.body:
Every piece that leaves this counter comes back through it. We see what holds, what fades, and what it was looked after with. Hundreds of times a year.

So we built the thing that couldn't be bought.
settings.mono_line: Squires Ink · Orchid Avenue · Surfers Paradise

settings.title: Heavy metals
settings.text: Not detected. Lead, arsenic, mercury, cadmium, bismuth.

settings.heading: Fifteen years under the needle.
settings.quote: Nothing goes on a client's skin that has not been proven on my own first.
settings.attr_role: Collector of fifteen years · Owner, Squires Ink
settings.body: TEL was not built at a distance. It was built at the counter of a working studio on Orchid Avenue, by a collector who has taken work from Sydney to Bali and still sits in the chair today.

settings.heading: Five hundred sets.
settings.body: Doors open Thursday 10 September. Sealed, never sold apart. When they're gone, Chapter One closes.

settings.heading: You trusted it on your skin.
settings.body: Hundreds of fresh pieces through the studio. One standard. Chapter Two gets named when it's ready, and you hear first.
settings.micro: One email when it opens. Nothing else.
